text: Ɗuuɗii e ca'e mofte adinooɓe, ɓurnooɓe tiiɗude doole e jawle e ɓiɗɓe, e dii ndee saare Makka, nde yimɓe mun raɗi maa e mun, Men halkuno ɓen fow, ko ɓe fenniri kon Nulaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen. Ballo woo alanaaɓe, mo no daɗnda ɓe e lepte Allah ɗen, si ɗe aranii ɓe. Awa Men ronkataa halkude yimɓe Makko ɓen kadi, si Men faandanike ɗum.
